description: The file defines a PHP class TimesheetPeriodSubscriber that subscribes to HTTP request events in a Symfony-based PHP application. It handles requests related to the timesheet period configuration, throwing exceptions or forwarding requests based on configuration status.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber that listens for HTTP request events to manage timesheet period configuration checks and request forwarding or authorization enforcement.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events to which this subscriber listens, specifically the Kernel's REQUEST event with a priority of 100.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the incoming request event, checks if the request path relates to timesheet configuration or API, and throws exceptions or allows for forwarding based on configuration status.
